sentences.text: Criminal Original Petition is filed under Section 528 of  BNSS, 2023, to direct to the 1st and 2nd respondents to Transfer of  Investigation of the case in Cr.No.4/2024 from the file of the 5th  respondent Police to some other competent investigation agency more  particularly the 3rd and 4th respondents for further investigation   final report before the concerned Court within the time stipulated   Court.

For Petitioner : Mr.M.Shakulhameed,
 For Respondents : M.Sakthi Kumar,
 Government Advocate (Crl.Side)
 ORDER Seeking transfer of investigation in Crime No.4 of 2024 from the file of the fifth respondent to some other competent investigation agency, this criminal original petition is filed.
2.The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner is the defacto complainant, on whose instance, FIR in Crime No.4 of 2024 was registered by the fifth respondent for the offences under Sections 420 of IPC and Section 66D of Information Technology (Amendment) Act, 2008, alleging that the accused persons through online platform, induced the petitioner to invest amount by https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 12/03/2026 08:19:07 pm ) assuring higher commission on the investment and thereafter, cheated him after receiving amount of Rs.9,20,200/-.
Since no substantive progress is made in the investigation, the present petition has been filed.
3.The learned Government Advocate (crl.side), on instructions, submitted that investigation is almost completed.
4.Heard the learned counsel on either side and carefully perused the materials available on record.

5.In view of the submission made by the learned Government Advocate (Crl.side), the fifth respondent is directed to conclude the investigation in Crime No.4 of 2024 within a period of two months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.

The second respondent police is directed to monitor the ongoing investigation which is undertaken by the fifth respondent and the fifth respondent is directed to appraise the progress of the investigation from time to time every Friday to the second respondent.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 12/03/2026 08:19:07 pm )
6.With the above directions, this Criminal Original Petition is disposed of.
